story.title: Gapuram a great helper
paragraphs_en: Gapuram was a very grateful elephant, as all the villagers built a house to keep him safe.

One day the villagers became very poor and they did not have money. They started starving without food. The milkman did not have milk, the tailor closed the shop as he did not have money to buy the needle. The postman passed the message all across the village, that the people are dying out of hunger.
Gapuram. heard about the news and felt very sad. He then decided that he must help villagers. He thought about ideas all night.
The next day, he became magical elephant. He realised that he can deliver food just like food delivery boys.

He walked miles away from the village and looked for a restaurant where he could bring food for the villagers. He took rest under a huge tree in the afternoon as he was tired. He woke up in the evening and made a loud sound by yawning.

He started walking ahead and saw a beautiful lit place. He said " Voila, here is the restaurant. " He felt happy and started walking towards it. He requested the manager. to give food to the villagers who were very poor. The restaurant people felt very empathetic, they did a charity for poor people.

dân làng (những người sống trong làng)
an toàn (không bị nguy hiểm)
nghèo (không có nhiều tiền)
đói lả (rất rất đói, không có gì ăn)
thợ may (người may quần áo)

tin tức (thông tin mới)
quyết định (chọn làm một điều gì đó)

thần kỳ (có phép thuật, đặc biệt)
nhận ra (hiểu ra điều gì đó)
giao (mang đến cho ai đó)
dặm (đơn vị đo khoảng cách, rất xa)
nhà hàng (nơi bán đồ ăn)
to lớn (rất lớn)
ngáp (mở miệng rộng khi mệt hoặc buồn ngủ)
